90: When she is a captive - if he had first set his eyes upon her then. But not if he had [previously] bought her in order to sell or to be a maidservant, and then set his eyes upon her.

"A beautiful woman" - this implies that she was permitted to him because her beauty inflamed his inclination. And [she was permitted to him only] reluctantly; but better that a Jew eat meat from a slaughtered dying animal -- that is, from a slaughtered animal that was critically ill -- even though it is loathsome, as is written in Ezekiel, "nor has foul flesh entered my mouth" (Ezekiel 4:14).
And let them not eat the meat of dying animals - after they have died, when they will have become carcasses.
